## 1. AI Tooling Disclosure & Five Substantive Reasons to Verify These Numbers Independently

This reference site and companion PDF brief were initiated and reviewed by **Matthew R.V. Ross** using **Google DeepMind’s Antigravity** coding agent to execute an open-source, reproducible **R (`4.5.2`) + Quarto (`1.10`)** pipeline (`src/00_setup_theme.R` through `src/05_verify_audit.R`). When evaluating an AI-assisted fiscal analysis on a contested campus topic, readers appropriately ask: *"Why should anyone trust these numbers?"* Five concrete analytical safeguards—and two places where cross-checking overturned initial assumptions—anchor the answers:

1. **Zero Unverified LLM Memory (Deterministic R Computation From 70 Archived Filings):** Not a single dollar amount, headcount, or percentage in any chart or table originates from language-model recall. Script `01_fetch_sources.R` downloaded and SHA-256 hashed 70 primary public PDFs, governance memos, and federal/BLS API tables across CSU Office of Budgets, CSU IRP&E Fact Books, CDHE Format 30/20 Budget Data Books, CSU System Audited Financial Statements (`FY15–FY25`), Colorado Office of the State Auditor (OSA) statutory NCAA Agreed-Upon Procedures reports (`2516F-B`, `2505F-B`), BLS CPI-U (`CUUR0000SA0`), and Urban Institute IPEDS (`2015–2023`), logging exact source URLs and page/table references in [`data/sources_manifest.csv`](data/sources_manifest.csv).
2. **Multi-Ledger Accounting Triangulation Across Independent Entities:** Every headline claim is cross-checked across at least two independent reporting systems—reconciling CSU internal `ColOBS` division budgets (`B2 Athletics $16.91M` FY25 / `$17.15M` FY26) against Colorado State Auditor NCAA filings (`2516F-B`), `Fact Book FY27` workforce tables against continuous `CDHE Format 30` Budget Data Books (`FINAL_BDB`), and CSU System Financial Statements against U.S. Department of Education IPEDS series.
3. **Testing and Overturning Initial Premises When Primary Data Disagreed:**
   - **What overturned the initial "faculty + admin grew equally" premise:** Fact Book FY27 (`Table 128`) makes E&G Faculty appear to jump `+43.3%` (`901.0 → 1,291.0` FTE, FY15–FY25) because pre-2019 `"Special"` and `"Temporary"` instructors vanish from active rank tables and reappear in FY19–FY20 as newly formalised `"Contract"` and `"Continuing"` (`CCA`) faculty under the April 2018 Faculty Manual Section E reform. Triangulating against continuous `CDHE Format 30` Budget Data Books shows true continuous **E&G Faculty FTE grew `+7.2%` over nine years (`1,528.6` in FY17 → `1,638.5` in FY26, `-0.8%` vs. FY20)** and Tenured/TT grew `+2.2%`, whereas **E&G Administrative Professional FTE rose `+62.3%` (`FY15–FY25`), including `+30.6%` (`+326.3` FTE) after FY22** (`62.1%` in Central VP/Admin/Spur units).
   - **Where headline-only critiques fall short mathematically:** Simultaneously, testing headline flashpoints against CSU's `$885.16M` FY26 E&G budget and `$66.0M` FY28 midpoint gap shows `B2 Athletics ($17.15M)` + `XA Debt Service ($31.86M)` equal **5.5% of E&G (`8.0%` of 10-year E&G growth)**, and cutting 100% of net Athletics support (`~$15.57M`) plus `$1.43M` in recent transition payouts still leaves **~76% (`~$50M/yr`)** of the FY28 shortfall unresolved.
4. **Disaggregating Self-Supporting Grants & Controlling Accounting Transfers:** Rather than treating all-funds staff ratios (`~3:1`) as uniform E&G overhead, `Fact Book Table 123–124` isolates **69.7% (`3,205.5` of `4,597.7`) of FY25 Administrative Professional FTE funded outside E&G** (`Sponsored Programs`, `Other Funds`, `Recharge Centers`, `Auxiliaries` across units such as CIRA, CEMML, VTH, AES, Extension, and CSFS). Likewise, `ColOBS` division analyses adjust explicitly for FY19's **\$41.64M** aid shift (`XA` to `P1`) and FY26's **~\$111.26M** pooled fringe decentralization so accounting transfers are never mislabeled as organic spending spikes.
5. **Independent Two-Way Verification & Open Programmatic Assertions (`src/05_verify_audit.R`):** Claims circulating from both administration and faculty critics were independently verified against public filings and press archives—confirming the `$1.10M` Parsons and `$325k` Underwood settlements (`$1.43M` combined), Coach Mora's `$2.4M`–`$2.8M` base / `$1.5M` UConn buyout package, and zero CSU employment tie for Title IX consultant Jeff Lamoureux. Seven programmatic checks in `src/05_verify_audit.R` verify all ledger balances and partitions on every build, and all source scripts and processed tables are published openly so any reader can inspect or challenge every calculation.

*Corrections, missing primary citations, or alternative accounting interpretations from any member of the CSU community are welcomed via [`github.com/matthewross07/csu_budget_context`](https://github.com/matthewross07/csu_budget_context).*

## 2. Accounting Scope & Deflation Notes

1. **CSU System vs. Fort Collins Standalone Scope (`finstmt2015–2025` vs. `BDB`/`ColOBS`/`OSA`):**
   - **CSU System Audited Statements** combine Fort Collins, CSU Pueblo, and System/SPUR (`$644.9M` net tuition, `21.3%` discount rate, `$1,330.7M` long-term debt in FY25 + `$79.1M` STRATA ATLAS Laser bonds issued June 26, 2025).
   - **Fort Collins Standalone Scope** comes from CDHE Format 30/20 Budget Data Books (`FINAL_BDB`), CSU Office of Budgets Operating Budget Summaries (`ColOBS` + `OBS`), IRP&E Fact Books (`Tables 122–128`), and Note 5 of Colorado OSA Report `2516F-B` (`$1,118.77M` Fort Collins total debt, including `$206.96M` Athletics debt).
2. **Real-Dollar Deflation (`CPI-U`, `macro_cpiu_fy.csv`):**
   - Monthly BLS CPI-U All Urban Consumers (`CUUR0000SA0`, 2014–Oct 2026) is averaged across CSU's July–June fiscal calendar so multi-year net tuition and debt series are evaluated in constant FY25 or FY26 purchasing power (`FY27` covers `Jul–Oct 2026`).

## 3. Documented Data Gaps & Portal Blocks (`DATA_GAPS.md`)

```{r tbl-gaps}
gaps_tbl <- tibble::tibble(
  `Source / Dataset` = c(
    "Knight-Newhouse Athletics Database",
    "U.S. GAO Report GAO-26-108640",
    "IRP&E Bare Domain (ir.colostate.edu)",
    "Oct. 14, 2026 Fall Forum PDF (Slides 14–15)",
    "CSU Fact Book FY27 Table 128",
    "Urban Institute IPEDS Panel"
  ),
  `Observed Constraint` = c(
    "HTTP 403 Forbidden to automated requests (anti-bot gate).",
    "HTTP 403 Forbidden when requesting full PDF from gao.gov.",
    "Bare hostname fails DNS resolution without www prefix.",
    "Public online PDF exports Slides 14–15 with blank white scenario table areas.",
    "Omits FY21–FY24 E&G-only State Classified FTE rows (reports FY15–FY20 and FY25).",
    "Harmonized Finance & HR API data run through FY23."
  ),
  `Primary Fallback / Mitigation Used` = c(
    "Colorado OSA Statutory NCAA AUP PDFs (csu_ncaa_aup_fy19..fy25, 2516F-B, and cub_ncaa_aup_fy25, 2505F-B)—the audited filings Knight-Newhouse ingests.",
    "Published summary figures (nocap_gao_26_108640_summary.html: Power-4 $120.3M vs. G5 $21.0M) paired with OSA Note 5 debt.",
    "Retrieved directly via https://www.ir.colostate.edu/.",
    "Exact $61.3M–$70.7M shortfall, ~$25M enrollment drop, and $15.112M stopgap figure sourced from Oct. 7 Memo & May 13 V4 Slide 6.",
    "Left uninterpolated (NA); longitudinal comparisons anchor on FY15 vs. FY25 E&G endpoints alongside all-funds Table 122/123.",
    "Anchored 8-institution peer panel on FY23 IPEDS alongside FY25 statutory OSA AUP debt benchmarks."
  ),
  `Manual Reference / Verification` = c(
    "https://knightnewhousedata.org/fbs/mwc/colorado-state-university",
    "https://www.gao.gov/assets/gao-26-108640.pdf",
    "https://www.ir.colostate.edu/",
    "source_oct07_2026_early_look_budget.html; Campus-V4-5-13-2026_a-1.pdf",
    "CSU_Factbook_FY27_2026-10-22.pdf (pp. 142–147)",
    "data/processed/peer_benchmarks_2023.csv"
  )
)

csu_gt(
  gaps_tbl,
  title = "Audit Log of Upstream Portal Blocks, Posting Gaps & Accounting Boundaries",
  subtitle = "Documented in DATA_GAPS.md Without Bypassing Access Controls or Silently Interpolating Missing Cells"
)
```

## 4. Complete Primary Source Manifest (`r nrow(manifest)` Verified Files & APIs)

```{r tbl-manifest}
manifest |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    `Size (KB)` = formatC(file_bytes / 1024, format = "f", digits = 1, big.mark = ","),
    `SHA-256 (Prefix)` = substr(sha256, 1, 12)
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(
    ID = source_id,
    Category = category,
    Title = title,
    `Fiscal Years` = fiscal_years,
    `Local Path` = rel_path,
    `Size (KB)`,
    `SHA-256 (Prefix)`,
    Status = status
  ) |>
  csu_gt(
    title = paste0("Complete Primary Source Ledger (N = ", nrow(manifest), " Verified Files & APIs)"),
    subtitle = "Every archived source is SHA-256 checksummed in data/sources_manifest.csv"
  )
```

## 5. Reproducibility Commands

To re-run the entire pipeline from scratch inside `CSU_finance/`:

```bash
# 1. Fetch/verify all 70 primary sources, parse PDFs/APIs, generate figures, and run audit assertions
Rscript src/run_all.R

# 2. Render standalone PDF brief into outputs/pdf/
quarto render report.qmd --to pdf
mv CSU_Budget_Context_FY27_28.pdf outputs/pdf/CSU_Budget_Context_FY27_28.pdf

# 3. Render static Quarto website into docs/ (configured with robots.txt + noindex headers)
quarto render
```
